best_idea: A round or hold timer that only ever moves later on activity (with a minimum extension), plus a schedule that adds a growing increment every N rounds with a hard cap that switches the schedule off.
decision_why: The extend-only deadline and the capped escalation schedule fit a grace or round timer if they are zone data; the turn and phase model and wall-clock deadline do not fit a tick-based fight.
acceptance: Fight test: a round timer with base 60 s and +30 s every 2 rounds gives rounds 2 to 6 the values 60, 90, 90, 120, 120 s and clamps and switches off at the maximum; zone test: a 20 s grace timer is pushed to now plus 20 s whenever a player is seen inside coverage, never earlier, and the zone despawns once it expires with no one seen.
